title: Lemon Squeezy is shutting down. Here’s how to move your business to xPay
summary: Recieve Global Card and Banking Payments at 95% Success Rates and 45+ Global Payment methods in 140+ countries and 110+ currencies.
body_markdown:
If you sell software, courses or subscriptions to customers abroad, you have probably seen the news: Lemon Squeezy is winding down, and it will stop taking payments on **31 March 2027** . That is about four and a half months away.


The good news: xPay gives you a payment gateway **together with sales tax and non-sales tax** , so you can move from Lemon Squeezy easily and keep everything in one place. There is enough time to do it calmly, if you start now. This guide explains what is happening, how xPay is different, and the exact steps to move your business and your customers.


## **What is happening**


On 16 November 2026, Lemon Squeezy announced that it was winding down. Here are the dates that matter:


Lemon Squeezy is asking merchants to move to Stripe Managed Payments, but that product is not open in every country. India, for example, is not on Stripe’s current list of supported business locations. If your business is in a country that is not covered, you need another provider.


**That is where we come in.** xPay is open to registered businesses in India, Singapore, the UK, the US and the UAE. And if your country is covered but you simply want more control over your payments and tax, we are a good fit too.


**Don’t wait.** Moving payments is not a one-day job. You need to get verified, set up your checkout, test it, and move your subscribers. Add the holidays, and the time goes fast.


## **How xPay is different**


xPay is a payment gateway that also takes care of your tax, both sales tax and non-sales tax, so you can run everything in one place and move over from Lemon Squeezy easily. Here is what you get:


-


**More payments go through.** We see 95%+ success on international payments. That means fewer lost sales and fewer angry emails.


-


**Customers pay the way they like.** 45+ payment methods, including Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal, plus pay-later options like Klarna and Afterpay.


-


**Subscriptions in 100+ currencies.** Charge monthly or yearly, by payment link or through our API.


-


**Sales Tax, taken care of.** Sales tax and non-sales tax, together with your payments. Sales Tax Autopilot covers sales tax in 100+ places, and our team walks you through the setup.


-


**Fast payouts.** Bank payments settle in 24 hours. Indian businesses get FIRC in the dashboard and money in their INR account.


-


**A risk score on every payment** , so you can spot problem transactions early.


-


**Real people, quickly.** A reply within 10 minutes, by phone or WhatsApp.


## **How to move: 4 steps**


1.


**Export your data and list what you use.** Download your customers, orders and subscriptions using Lemon Squeezy’s[export guide](https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/help/orders/exporting-orders) . Then write down everything Lemon Squeezy does for you today: payments, subscriptions, tax, license keys, file delivery, emails. Many sellers found it did more than they remembered.


2.


**Create your xPay account and get verified.**[Start here](https://app.xpaycheckout.com/user-register) and send your business details. Verification takes time, so do this first, not last.


3.


**Set up your checkout.** No developer? Create a payment link in a few clicks and share it. Have a developer? Use our[API docs](https://docs.xpaycheckout.com/) to add xPay to your website or app.


4.


**Move your subscribers and go live.** Fill in Lemon Squeezy’s[migration form](https://app.lemonsqueezy.com/settings/migration) and share your export with us. We tell you early which plans can move as they are and which customers confirm their card once, and we give you simple email text to send. Test with a few real payments, then move customers in small groups. Switch off the old checkout last.


**A simple timeline:** set up your account and export your data by mid-December, build and test your checkout through January, move your subscribers in February, and keep March as your safety buffer.


## **Questions you may have**


**Do I need a registered business?** Yes. xPay works with registered businesses in India, Singapore, the US and the UAE. If you are not sure about your setup,[talk to us](https://www.xpaycheckout.com/Contact-Us) . A short call is enough to find the quickest way to get live.


**Can I keep my subscribers?** In most cases you keep your customers and their plans. Providers often cannot move saved card details between systems. If that applies to you, your customer adds their card once through a secure link and their plan carries on. We tell you early which customers are in which group, so nothing surprises you in March.


**Does xPay deliver files or license keys?** No. Keep file delivery and license keys on your own site or tools. xPay connects through payment links and our API, and we help you plan this part on your first call.


**How does tax work?** xPay handles sales tax and non-sales tax together with your payments. Our team walks you through the setup for your business on your first call.


**How do refunds and disputes work?** Our team walks you through this for your setup. The risk score on each payment also helps you catch problems early.


**What does it cost?** See our[pricing page](https://www.xpaycheckout.com/pricing) . We do not add hidden charges, and there is no limit on how much you can charge in one payment. Want your exact numbers? Email us your monthly sales and your current Lemon Squeezy fee, and we will send you a side-by-side.


**Is it safe?** Yes. xPay is PCI DSS compliant, which is the standard for keeping card data safe.


## **Ready to move?**


The deadline will not move, and the earlier you start, the calmer your move will be. Tell us you are coming from Lemon Squeezy, and our team will plan it with you.
